extractableAnswerBlocks.answer: Cheek acne in India is primarily caused by physical friction from dirty phone screens, helmet straps, and heavy hair oil (Champi) residue, combined with monsoon humidity.
extractableAnswerBlocks.aiOverviewDelta: Provides a direct, friction-focused explanation rather than generic skin oil advice.

extractableAnswerBlocks.answer: Perform a cheek audit: clean your phone daily, wash helmet straps weekly, swap cotton pillowcases for silk, and avoid heavy hair oil runoff.
keywordUse: how to stop cheek acne india
extractableAnswerBlocks.aiOverviewDelta: Creates a structured habit-audit checklist instead of immediate product purchase prompts.

extractableAnswerBlocks.answer: If your cheek breakouts are deep, painful, and do not improve after 4 weeks of habit correction, consult a dermatologist to prevent permanent rolling scars.
extractableAnswerBlocks.aiOverviewDelta: Sets clear dermatologist escalation rules to protect the thin cheek skin barrier.
